title: First-time exploitation of Pranlukast's intrinsic fluorescence: a novel cetrimide-enhanced spectrofluorimetric platform for pharmaceutical, plasma, and content uniformity analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37684-37704
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05505A, Paper

A cetrimide-enhanced spectrofluorimetric method provides rapid, sensitive, and eco friendly determination of Pranlukast in pharmaceuticals and plasma, validated with multiple sustainability tools and aligned with UN-SDGs.
